barcodeSection.autoHint: Auto picks the right symbology from the barcode value.

text.sellingHint: Fully editable, prints exactly as typed — e.g. Offer 499/-. No gap is added automatically before the suffix; type a leading space yourself (e.g. " /-") if you want one. MRP prints separately above it.
text.currencyHint: Printed PDF can't render ₹ cleanly on all printers — "None" prints just the number (e.g. MRP 1,300).
text.numberFormatHint: Applies to both MRP and Selling/Offer price — write the number however reads best on your label.
text.cutPriceHint: On: MRP prints with a line through it (e.g. ₹1,300). Off: MRP prints as a plain number.
text.skuMissingWarning: This product has no SKU set — add one in Edit Product, or the SKU line won't print.
text.otherCodeMissingWarning: This product has no Other Code set — add one in Edit Product, or the line won't print.

qr.hint: Higher = more damage-tolerant but larger QR pattern. Medium is a safe default.

position.rotationHint: 90° / 270° print the label sideways — useful when a horizontal barcode won't fit a narrow roll. The page size rotates with it. (Not applied to A4 sheets.)

calibration.intro: Print a calibration ruler, measure with a real ruler, then adjust below. Example: if the printed 100 mm mark measures 98 mm on your ruler, set Horizontal to 102%.
calibration.offsetHint: Shifts the content on the sticker if your printer prints too far left/up. Vertical = feed offset. Example: +1.0 / −0.5 mm.
calibration.footerNote: Applied only to barcode labels — invoices and other prints are never touched. Print density & feed gap are set in your printer's own driver/utility, not from the browser.

printScale.title: Print Scale: 100%
printScale.body1: In the browser print dialog: Destination = your label printer, Paper size = same as this label, Scale = 100% / Actual Size. Do NOT use "Fit to Page".
printScale.body2: ⚠ Testing with Save as PDF / Microsoft Print to PDF? Change that PDF printer's paper size to match this label — otherwise Chrome will rotate/scale to A4 and it will look wrong even though the real label printer will print correctly.

notes.pnl: Gross Profit uses each sale's recorded cost basis at the time of billing. "Book / Software Profit" above is not the same as Taxable Income — final tax treatment is to be determined by your CA/Accountant.
notes.gstInput: Input GST as recorded in Vyapar Sarthi — eligibility to be reviewed by your CA/Accountant.
notes.tradingAccountBasis: Opening Stock is estimated by replaying recorded purchases, purchase returns, sales and sales returns from the start of this period against current stock, valued at each product's recorded Cost Price (same basis as Purchases, so Opening + Purchases − Closing gives a real COGS) — not a date-accurate historical valuation.

notes.tradingAccountNoAdjustments: No manual stock adjustments were recorded in this period.
notes.stockSummary: Variant-level quantities are already netted into each product's single current stock total (no double counting) — see Products for the colour/size breakdown of that total. Stock valued at recorded selling price.
notes.cashBank: This app tracks a Cash Book (physical cash movements — sales, purchases, expenses, refunds and withdrawals paid/received in cash) and each sale's recorded payment mode; it does not maintain a separate bank-account ledger or bank reconciliation. Figures for UPI/Card/other modes below are collections recorded against that mode, not a bank statement.
